1879060133.name: To the King
1879060133.desc: Throw your full weight into a powerful attack against a single foe.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires the use of Thrust or Overwhelm.</rgb>

1879072549.name: Snap Out of It!
1879072549.desc: Your fury rouses yourself when you are dazed, stunned, rooted, or knocked down.

1879073701.name: Cut
1879073701.desc: A sweeping cut that can damage multiple targets in front of you.

1879094821.name: Warding Knowledge
1879094821.desc: Creates a warded circle in which you and your allies take reduced damage.

1879096869.name: Scribe Manual: Drums
1879096869.desc: This will scribe a manual to teach others to play the drum. Doing so is much more taxing than training in person and requires a Blank Mentor Manual.

1879109285.name: Rune of Restoration
1879109285.desc: Places a healing Runestone upon the ground, healing nearby allies.

1879139749.name: Shadow's Bite
1879139749.desc: You bite your opponent and drink deeply, draining your target's power and leaving them terrified.

1879209893.name: Steed of the Burglar
1879209893.desc: A mount carrying all the trappings that are used and needed by the burglar.

1879216037.name: Improved Cutting Attack
1879216037.desc: A bleed that deals damage-over-time and slows movement speed.

1879226917.name: Ring of Shadow
1879226917.desc: Utilize the power of Shadow to counter Saruman's attempts to drain this ring of its power.

1879230501.name: Howl of Aggression
1879230501.desc: You let loose a fierce howl, disarming enemies around you. <rgb=#00ff00>\n \n Disarms target.</rgb>

1879241637.name: Call of the Eorlingas
1879241637.desc: Your Call restores heart to nearby allies and their war-steeds.

1879266853.name: Grey Courage
1879266853.desc: As the leader of the Grey Company, Halbarad can draw upon his position to inspire himself to great acts of strength, increasing his melee damage.

1879272101.name: Legend of Helm Hammerhand
1879272101.desc:
All Fellows gain a Morale Bubble.

If the bubble is broken, no effect will be gained.

If the bubble expires, it will grant a small fellowship heal.

Bubble strength is 10% of the targets' Max Morale pool before other bonuses apply.

1879284901.name: Banner - Vanguard
1879284901.desc: Place a banner that improves Vanguards.

1879415717.name: Obvious Portent of Strength
1879415717.desc: A quick burst of strength, increasing the amount of damage you do.

1879416229.name: Copper Goat
1879416229.desc: Summons a goat to keep you company.

1879445157.name: Muster at Tornhad
1879445157.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Tornhad

1879454885.name: Return to the Tracery Archives in Rivendell
1879454885.desc: You're able to quickly return to the Word-hoard in Rivendell. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879457445.name: Call Lágsaith
1879457445.desc: You can use this horn to call Lágsaith to your side.

1879459109.name: Cutting Strike
1879459109.desc: Your Herald strikes multiple targets in melee range.

1879459365.name: Test Power Drain
1879459365.desc: Does fixed effect to test buffs and mitigations.

1879467813.name: Savage Knockdown (Dual)
1879467813.desc: Consuming all of your Wrath, you put all your energy into a savage attack that damages and knocks down up to 5 enemies before you, allowing your escape.

1879491493.name: Muster at Iridír
1879491493.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Iridír in Ambarûl in the Ikorbân Valley.

1879501349.name: Guide to Utug-bûr
1879501349.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to the Temple of Utug-bûr, in the far reaches of Urash Dâr in the Ikorbân Valley.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879506597.name: Prepared: Flame Breath
1879506597.desc: Using fell knowledge and potions, breathe a gout of flame in front of you.

1879521317.name: Diligent Mûmak Calf
1879521317.desc: Summons a diligent mûmak calf to accompany you on your travels.

1879528485.name: Eagle-Owl of the Flowering Sun
1879528485.desc: Summons an eagle-owl to accompany you on your travels.

1879529509.name: Spring Copse Stag
1879529509.desc: Summons a spring copse stag to accompany you on your travels.
